messages.subject: Marsden — payroll instruction & tax treatment
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca — for payroll: the first £30,000 of the £95,000 ex gratia is tax free under ss.401–403 ITEPA; the balance plus the £24,850 bonus and £4,380 holiday go through PAYE. Outplacement and the £1,500 fee contribution are exempt. Total employer cost including Class 1A NIC is c.£143,700. The settlement payment schedule sets out the full computation — please pay within 28 days of the later of termination and receipt of the signed agreement and certificate.

Kind regards,
Sarah
